title: PhysxVehicleAPI
summary: Makes a rigid body the chassis of a PhysX vehicle whose wheels are the descendants with PhysxVehicleWheelAttachmentAPI. Listing it turns on vehicle parsing for the attach; the walkers enumerate the prims that list it, and the runtime then resolves the drive, checks which other vehicle APIs the prim lists, and validates and creates the vehicle.

columns.name: physxVehicle:drive
columns.absent: No drive from the relationship: a PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI or PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI on the vehicle prim itself is the drive (both listed logs an error and the vehicle is not created); with neither the vehicle has no drive, and PhysxVehicleWheelControllerAPI on its wheel attachments is the only torque input.
columns.notes: An empty target list counts as absent. More than one target logs an error and the vehicle is not created. A single target wins over drive APIs on the vehicle prim and must resolve to a parsed PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI or PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI prim (standard is looked up first); a target that does not (for example a dangling one) logs an error and the vehicle is not created.

columns.name: usd-metadata:customData:physxVehicle:referenceFrameIsCenterOfMass
columns.absent: The legacy vehicle frame is the center-of-mass frame.

producer.writes: the nested customData physxVehicle -> referenceFrameIsCenterOfMass value

interactions.rule: Required on the same prim, which must also be Xformable; otherwise the runtime logs an error and the vehicle is not created. physics:rigidBodyEnabled false, or physics:kinematicEnabled true while physxVehicle:vehicleEnabled is true, also invalidates the vehicle.

notes: The runtime checks whether the vehicle prim lists PhysxVehicleMultiWheelDifferentialAPI, PhysxVehicleTankDifferentialAPI, PhysxVehicleSteeringAPI, PhysxVehicleAckermannSteeringAPI or PhysxVehicleBrakesAPI; when one is listed but its parser rejected the data, the vehicle is not created. Each of them, and PhysxVehicleControllerAPI, needs the vehicle to have a drive.

The runtime also reads physxVehicle:vehicleEnabled, limitSuspensionExpansionVelocity, subStepThresholdLongitudinalSpeed, lowForwardSpeedSubStepCount, highForwardSpeedSubStepCount, the four slip-denominator attributes, the sticky-tire speed, time and damping attributes, physxVehicle:suspensionLineQueryType and the customData flag physxVehicle:referenceFrameIsCenterOfMass. Live changes are applied to vehicleEnabled, limitSuspensionExpansionVelocity, the sticky-tire attributes and every slip denominator except the deprecated minLongitudinalSlipDenominator. They are not described yet.

At load the runtime fills the lateral sticky-tire threshold time from physxVehicle:longitudinalStickyTireThresholdTime (a historical schema mismatch), so physxVehicle:lateralStickyTireThresholdTime is not read at load and only takes effect as a live change.
